description: This is a test class for the BookController in a Java Spring application, containing unit tests for various controller methods such as retrieving all books, finding by ID, updating, deleting, and getting genres.

classes.name: BookControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BookController, testing various endpoints and behaviors.

methods.name: all_pageNumberIsOptional
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method calls the service with a null page parameter when no page is specified.

methods.name: all_returnsEmptyList_whenNoBooksExist
methods.description: Verifies that the 'all' method returns an empty list when the service finds no books.

methods.name: all_returnsBadRequest_whenNegativePage
methods.description: Checks that the 'all' method throws a ResponseStatusException with BAD_REQUEST status for negative page numbers.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenBooksExist
methods.description: Verifies that the 'all' method returns a list of books when books exist.

methods.name: findById_returnsBook_ifPresent
methods.description: Tests that 'findById' returns the correct Book object when it exists.

methods.name: findById_returnsNotFound_ifBookIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that 'findById' throws a ResponseStatusException with NOT_FOUND status when the book does not exist.

methods.name: findByShelf_returnsNotFound_ifBookDoesNotExist
methods.description: Placeholder for a test to verify behavior when a book by shelf, title, or author is not found (currently commented out).

methods.name: update_callsService_ifBookPresent
methods.description: Tests that the 'update' method calls the service to update a book when the book exists.

methods.name: update_throwsNotFoundException_ifBookNotPresent
methods.description: Verifies that 'update' throws a ResponseStatusException with NOT_FOUND status if the book does not exist.

methods.name: getGenres_alwaysReturnsNonEmptyArray
methods.description: Checks that 'getGenres' always returns a non-empty array.

methods.name: delete_returnsNotFound_ifBookDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that deleting a non-existent book returns a response with NOT_FOUND status.

methods.name: delete_returnsOk_ifBookExists
methods.description: Verifies that deleting an existing book returns a response with OK status.
